_meta.purpose: In-context rubric prototype: Claude-classified 30 real python SO questions (2023-06) to validate the AI-substitutability classifier before scaling to opus. Doubles as few-shot seed + human-gold seed.
_meta.rubric: score 0-4 on: self-containment / context-independence / judgment-vs-retrieval / unique-answer / one-shot. >=3 = GEN (ChatGPT answers from text alone), <3 = VER (needs the asker's specific context/debugging/judgment).
_meta.result: 13 GEN / 17 VER. KEY: substitutability is QUESTION-level, finer than tags — same pandas/django tag splits across GEN and VER.
